description: "Introducing our new collaborative research blog."
---

Welcome to **Sprang and Friends** — a space where we share research, code, and ideas in computational biology.

This blog is open to collaborators. If you'd like to contribute a post, check out the contribution guide in the repository. The workflow is simple:

1. Fork the repository
2. Create a new folder under `blog/posts/` named `YYYY-MM-DD-your-title/`
3. Write your post as `index.qmd`
4. Open a pull request

We look forward to sharing our work here. Stay tuned!
